"Dune: Part Two" will explore the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a warpath of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

Without a doubt visually the most beautiful movie I’ve ever seen in IMAX I think about it often and how I’ll never get to fully express what this movie looked like and sounded like opening night in IMAX to anyone that didn’t get to see it. This really wasn’t just a movie it was art. My eyes have never smiled so hard. This is an experience I will miss greatly.

## Movie Info

Synopsis
"Dune: Part Two" will explore the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a warpath of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.
